The art & science of incense-making at Hari Darshan has been inherited by four generations for over a century now; a passionate art of blending fragrances, and the science of making use of the best ingredients. jobs.jd: Role: VP IT Internal Audit | Technology Issue Management Location: Bengaluru Experience: 812 years Function: Internal Audit / Technology Risk / IT Controls We are looking for an experienced technology auditor or technology-risk professional to join MUFGs Internal Audit team in Bengaluru. The role will own the validation, reporting and ongoing monitoring of technology issues arising from audit activity. This is a senior individual-contributor and team-lead role. It requires sound independent judgement, strong written communication and the ability to challenge remediation evidence constructively while maintaining an objective third-line audit perspective. Key responsibilities Own a portfolio of technology-related audit issues from assignment through validation and closure recommendation. Understand the original audit finding, risk rating, root cause, management action plan and expected remediation outcome. jobs.jd: About Company BDO is a global network of professional services firms with a presence in over 166 countries, revenue of over USD 14 billion, and experience of over 60 years. Its a leading service provider for the mid-markets with client service at its heart. BDO India Services Private Limited (or BDO India) is the India member firm of BDO International. BDO India offers strategic, operational, accounting and tax, and regulatory advisory & assistance for both domestic and international organizations across a range of industries. BDO India is led by more than 300+ Partners & Directors with a team of over 10,000 professionals operating across 14 cities and 20 offices. We expect to grow sizably in the coming 3-5 years, adding various dimensions to our business and multiplying and increasing the current team size multi-fold. Review and validate the Trial Balance to ensure accuracy, completeness, and compliance with accounting standards. jobs.jd: Title: Finance Manager Growth Path to CFO Location: Mumbai, Maharashtra, India Company: AriMAx Global Pvt. Ltd. (Member of the AriMAx Group of Companies) About the role We're a US-based group of companies in the natural stone and building-materials industry (marble, terrazzo, and epoxy aggregates) with operations spanning the US and Turkey. We're building out our India finance function and looking for a finance leader who wants to grow with us — not just maintain the books but eventually own the financial strategy of the group as a CFO-type leader. This is a role with a real trajectory. You'll start by owning day-to-day finance and, as you prove yourself, take on progressively more responsibility across planning, controls, and management. What you'll do Own the India entity's accounting, financial reporting, and month-end close. Build and maintain financial controls, processes, and reporting infrastructure. Partner directly with ownership on financial planning and analysis Grow into a leadership role managing finance staff and shaping group-wide financial strategy What we're looking for Chartered Accountant (CA), MBA in Finance, or PGDM in Finance Strong communicator with fluency in English High emotional intelligence and the ability to work closely with ownership and cross-border teams Genuine appetite to grow into a senior leadership role — this is for someone ambitious, not someone looking to coast Self-directed and reliable, comfortable building structure where little exists Why this role You'll have a direct line to ownership, real ownership of your domain from day one, and a clear path to a CFO-level seat as the group grows. If you want to build something and grow with it, this is that role.

jobs.jd: Job Summary Roastea is hiring a Credit Controller for its Vending Vertical to manage accounts receivable and ensure timely collections. The role plays a key part in maintaining healthy cash flow, controlling credit exposure, and coordinating with internal teams to resolve billing and payment-related matters. This position requires strong follow-up skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple Client accounts efficiently. Key Responsibilities Manage end-to-end accounts receivable for the vending business. Ensure timely and accurate invoicing as per agreed commercial terms. Monitor aging reports and follow up on outstanding payments. Conduct client visits for payment follow-ups, reconciliations, and issue resolution. Travel locally as required to meet clients for collections and account discussions. Maintain accurate client ledger reconciliations and resolve discrepancies. Coordinate with Sales and Operations teams for billing or service-related disputes. Monitor credit limits and highlight potential risk accounts. Negotiate payment schedules where required. Drive timely collections and work towards reducing overdue balances. Prepare periodic reports on collections and receivables status. Every Month Invoice submission to the clients as per the communicated time line. Requirements Bachelors degree in Finance, Accounting, or Commerce. 3to6 years of experience in credit control or accounts receivable. Experience in FMCG, beverage, vending, or B2B service industry preferred. Strong knowledge of accounting systems and MS Excel. Good negotiation and communication skills (Kannada and English). Strong attention to detail and analytical ability. Ability to manage multiple accounts and meet collection targets.

jobs.requirement_text:
Job Role B2B Account Management / AMR – Structure & Operations Function: B2B Account Management / Customer Service Location: Gurgaon Shift: Night Shift – WFO About Group Bayport:- Group Bayport is a rapidly growing global e-Commerce B2B2C, B2B and B2C organization that has re-defined the business of delivering high-quality custom products through a unique blend of cutting-edge digital technologies, robust manufacturing capabilities, and global supply chain.
For more about Group Bayport, please visit Website: https://groupbayport.com/about-us/LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/groupbayport/mycompany/ Role Overview We are looking for an experienced B2B Customer Service / Account Management / Key Account Management professional who can support the development and establishment of a structured Account Management Representative (AMR) function for the B2B business The selected individual will work closely with business leadership to understand the existing B2B customer management model and help carve out a clearly defined AMR structure , roles, responsibilities, account ownership, operating processes, service standards, escalation mechanisms, and day-to-day ways of working.
This role requires strong hands-on experience in managing B2B customers and key accounts , along with the ability to translate practical account management experience into a structured and scalable operating framework.
Help identify the right people/resources required for the AMR function.
B2B Account & Customer Management Bring hands-on experience in managing B2B customers, strategic accounts, and key accounts .
Help improve customer engagement, retention, service quality, and overall account experience.
Support the business in resolving cross-functional gaps impacting customer experience.
Provide leadership with insights on account performance, customer concerns, escalations, and improvement opportunities Required Experience & Skills Graduate with preferably 3–6+ years of relevant professional experience .
Strong hands-on experience in one or more of the following: B2B Customer Service B2B Account Management Key Account Management B2B Client Servicing B2B Customer Success Prior experience managing business customers and complex account requirements.
Experience working with multiple internal stakeholders and cross-functional teams.
Preferred Profile Candidates who have previously worked in a structured B2B Account Management / Key Account Management / Customer Service environment and have experience in establishing, improving, or scaling account management processes will be preferred.
Experience in defining roles and responsibilities, customer ownership models, escalation frameworks, or account management structures will be an added advantage.
Key Deliverables The person selected for this role will be expected to support the business in developing: A clearly defined B2B AMR structure Identification of appropriate people/resources for the AMR function AMR roles and responsibilities Account ownership framework Customer management processes KRAs and KPIs Service standards and SLAs Customer escalation framework Account review mechanisms Cross-functional operating model Reporting and performance tracking mechanisms Day-to-day AMR operating framework Success Measures Establishment of a structured AMR operating model Clear identification of AMR ownership and responsibilities Defined KRAs, KPIs, and service standards Improved B2B customer management processes Stronger customer communication and escalation mechanisms Improved coordination between Account Management and internal stakeholders Increased clarity and accountability across the B2B customer journey Overall improvement in B2B customer experience and account management effectiveness

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in Accounts Receivable (AR), denial management, insurance follow-up, and outstanding claim resolution . Key Responsibilities Perform AR follow-up on outstanding and unpaid claims with US insurance companies. Make outbound calls to insurance companies regarding claim status, denials, underpayments, and payment issues. Identify the reason for claim denials and rejections and take appropriate action for resolution. Follow up on pending claims and ensure timely resolution of outstanding accounts. Review EOBs/ERAs and understand claim/payment details. Coordinate with internal teams for claim corrections, documentation, and resubmissions. Maintain accurate records of follow-ups and claim status. Meet defined productivity, quality, and collection targets . Ensure compliance with process guidelines and client requirements. Required Skills & Qualifications 1+ year of relevant experience as an AR Caller in US Healthcare RCM. Hands-on experience in AR Calling / Insurance Follow-up / Denial Management . Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Comfortable working in a US Night Shift environment. Good analytical and problem-solving skills. jobs.jd: Job Summary Glean is seeking a Senior Manager, Technical Accounting to lead complex accounting analysis, policy implementation, and controls across finance processes and systems. This role combines strong technical accounting judgment with hands-on execution: assessing new and complex transactions, documenting accounting conclusions, translating requirements into scalable processes, and implementing effective controls across the accounting environment. The successful candidate will partner closely with Accounting, Finance Systems, Revenue, FP&A, Tax, Legal, Sales Operations, Procurement, auditors, consultants, and business leaders. This role is well suited to a technically strong accounting leader who can move from accounting conclusion to operational implementation and sustainment. You will Lead technical accounting assessments and prepare clear, well-supported accounting memos under US GAAP and, where relevant, IFRS. Advise on revenue recognition, COGS, commissions, equity and stock-based compensation, investments, financial statements, leases, intercompany transactions, and other complex accounting matters. Evaluate new products, contracts, commercial arrangements, investments, and business initiatives for accounting and reporting implications. Maintain and improve accounting policies, position papers, documentation standards, and technical accounting playbooks. Partner with external auditors and advisors to resolve technical accounting questions and align on conclusions. Translate accounting conclusions into practical requirements for close procedures, reconciliations, reporting, systems configuration, and control activities.
